messages.text: I’ll trace the reported divide-by-zero through the matching GBTS source and preserved run logs, then propose a narrowly scoped correction and event-level regression plan.

The matching filter has an unguarded endcap path-length division by the squared longitudinal slope. A zero slope is a plausible trigger, but the log does not identify the denominator or event. I’m checking the other divisions and the saved pixel inputs before choosing the guard.

I’ll build the authorized diagnostic in its own directory. It will replay the saved pixel points through the shared implementation and two renamed copies, record the actual zero denominator, and compare ordered seeds and their exact quality bits before any correction is chosen.

The runtime imports resolve to the expected ACTS build despite the setup helper’s existing sandbox warnings. The first diagnostic compile caught two isolation details—a shared constant name and a C++ template qualifier—which I’m correcting in the new task-owned files.

The diagnostic module has built successfully. The saved-input replay is now running through all three implementations; it checks each event’s ordered seed indices and quality bits against the preserved production audit, with the FPE monitor active for each GBTS call.

Event 57 reproduces the fault while retaining exactly the original 4,889 seeds and quality bits. The compiled code evaluates the endcap division even on a barrel update, then discards its result. I’m capturing that barrel state; selecting a safe barrel denominator before division appears to address the fault without rejecting a valid candidate.

The replay has passed 70 events with exact seed and quality agreement. Event 57 is the only fault so far. Its 26,498 pixel points and 4,889 seeds are also identical across all four strixel configurations, confirming that they reach the same GBTS input.

All 100 events passed the exact seed and quality comparison; only event 57 raised the divide-by-zero. I’ve preserved that diagnostic’s binary, sources and provenance. A separate build will now capture the zero slope on the barrel update and record the faulting instruction’s offset.

SoftEng-07 completed against `250a211ff71be2ce7339cc043766f0d839470411`. All diagnostic jobs stopped; no numerical correction was implemented.

The fault is **speculative evaluation of an unselected division**. In event 57, two barrel points share exactly `z=169.1857452392578 mm`, producing slope `-0.0` and squared slope `+0.0`. Clang O2 executes the endcap expression `(1+tau²)/tau²` before selecting the barrel result.

Actual native disassembly and recorded fault agree:

- Shared ACTS Core: division at `0x23a714`, selection at `0x23a71c`.
- Instrumented copy: division at `0x69514`, selection at `0x6951c`.

**All 100 baseline pixel-input events passed exact ordered seed-index and quality-bit comparisons** between saved production, shared Core, renamed copy and instrumented copy. Only event 57 raised FLTDIV. Its 4,889 seeds also match across all four strixel cases. Replay took 192.35 seconds.

Four new owned sources provide isolated classes, compiled provenance and observational replay:
`CMakeLists.txt`, `Binding.cpp`, `DivisionAudit.hpp`, `generate.py`.

Evidence:

- [100-event report](/private/tmp/nodd-strixel-ttbar/gbts-diagnostic/run01/report.json)
- [Preserved original source/artifact manifest](/private/tmp/nodd-strixel-ttbar/gbts-diagnostic/run01-source-artifact/manifest.json)
- [Exact captured state](/private/tmp/nodd-strixel-ttbar/gbts-diagnostic/event57-capture-v2/actual-denominator-state.json)
- [Capture disassembly](/private/tmp/nodd-strixel-ttbar/gbts-diagnostic/capture-v2-update.asm)

Recommended correction for independent review: select the denominator first—`1.f` for barrel, `tau²` for endcap—then divide. This avoids candidate rejection or changed cuts. Machine-code verification, signed-zero/boundary FPE controls, exact output comparisons and production event-audit coverage remain required before use.
